Change Log

What changed in Practice Jazz Chords, newest first.

  1. 14 Nov 2026

    Install as an app from the menu bar; the installed app works offline

  2. 13 Nov 2026

    Redesign: light and dark mode, one-bar count-in, key ratings on a keyboard and new documentation

  3. 8 Dec 2025

    Play root note of current chord

  4. 7 Dec 2025

    Add “Weighted Cycle” mode

  5. 2 Mar 2025

    Add documentation for custom chord progressions

  6. 16 Feb 2025

    Add Imaj7–vi7–ii7–V7 chord progression, allow custom chord progressions

  7. 22 Jan 2025

    Add sitemap and robots.txt

  8. 20 Jan 2025

    Domain update: the app’s domain has been updated to practice-jazz-chords.com, all prior configurations need to be reapplied due to the domain transfer

  9. 18 Jan 2025

    Fix tone.js not playing audio on iOS, track usage statistics

  10. 12 Jan 2025

    Add tone.js, save configuration to localStorage, add probability based key selection

  11. 10 Jan 2025

    Angular 19 update, add Angular Material Design

  12. 8 Jan 2025

    Add modes “Perfect 4th up” and “Perfect 4th down”

Install Practice Jazz Chords

  1. Open the File menu in the menu bar.
  2. Choose Add to Dock, then Add.

Practice Jazz Chords then opens in its own window and works offline too.
